ClashGate/ClashGate.description: ClashGate — a simple, safe proxy server on the Mihomo core
ClashGate/ClashGate.body:
## Design philosophy

Simple, safe, bridging the last mile of the Mihomo ecosystem.

## What it can do

- **One-click proxy server deployment**: a single command deploys the Mihomo server on common Linux VPSes, ready to use out of the box.
- **Built-in client subscription**: automatically provides configuration that can be imported directly into Mihomo / Clash-family clients, with no manual assembly.
- **Multiple protocols supported**: add VLESS Reality, Shadowsocks, Hysteria2, Snell v6, AnyTLS, TUIC, TrustTunnel, ShadowQUIC, Mieru, and Sudoku with one click.
- **Server-side traffic routing**: for custom outbound routing, replace it with your own Mihomo server configuration.
- **Multilingual interface**: the management panel can switch between 中文, English, Русский, and فارسی; installation and the command line support 中文 and English.

## One-click install

Supports common Linux distributions with systemd (Ubuntu / Debian / Rocky / Alma / Fedora / CentOS; requires root):

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ClashGate/ClashGate/main/install.sh | bash
```

## Common commands

Run `clashgate` directly to open the menu, or:

```text
clashgate [status | info | sub | reset-sub | passwd | reset-password | reset-secret | cert | restart | log | update | uninstall | install | help]
```

## Directory

All under `/etc/clashgate/`:

- `config.yaml`: current server configuration
- `certs/`: `fullchain.pem` and `privkey.pem`
- `client/`: client subscription snippets
- `panel/`: management panel

# Apple Music for MyGo Music

Search and play in [MyGo Music](https://github.com/egoist/mygo-music). Audio quality defaults to 256 kbps AAC, with optional up to 24-bit/192 kHz ALAC high-resolution lossless support (setup method [see below](#lossless)).

[English](https://github.com/LYJW131/mygo-music-apple-music/blob/HEAD/README.en.md)

## Installation and Usage

1. Click the badge above and MyGo Music will ask whether to install it, or paste `https://github.com/LYJW131/mygo-music-apple-music` into "Settings → Plugins → `+`".
2. Set the source to **Apple Music**.
3. Click login and sign in with an Apple account that has a valid subscription. If your account uses a passkey or security key to sign in, see [below](#media-user-token).
4. In "Settings → Plugins → Apple Music", allow the launcher to start. The plugin's bundled `amhelper` decrypts songs locally and passes them to MyGo Music for direct playback, so you don't need to install ffmpeg separately. Only platforms without `amhelper`, such as Windows arm64, need to install [ffmpeg](https://ffmpeg.org).

### Logging In with media-user-token

MyGo Music's login window does not support passkeys. You can sign in in your own browser and then give the token to the plugin:

1. While signed in at [music.apple.com](https://music.apple.com), open developer tools (F12). Under "Application / Storage → Cookies → `https://music.apple.com`", copy the value of `media-user-token`.
2. Paste it into "Settings → Plugins → Apple Music → **Media User Token**". You can also paste the entire cookie string.

Once filled in, you are logged in. Clearing this field logs you out. When the token expires (usually after a few months), copy a new one and paste it in.

### Logging In with the Account in wrapper

If you have already logged into your account in [wrapper-manager](#lossless), you don't need to log in again in the plugin. Instead, enter that account's Apple ID under **Wrapper Account**. The plugin uses `amhelper` to get this account's media-user-token from the wrapper, and the wrapper refreshes the token itself on a regular basis. LeilaoMi/AutoMergePublicNodes-Optimized.description: Automatically aggregates public proxy nodes, uses sing-box real-connection tests to filter verified subscriptions, and outputs multi-format Clash/sing-box/V2Ray subscriptions with a health report
LeilaoMi/AutoMergePublicNodes-Optimized.body:
# AutoMergePublicNodes-Optimized

Every 6 hours, collects nodes from over 100 public subscription sources, runs a real proxy connection test on each one with sing-box, checks whether they can be reached from mainland China using probes, and finally outputs subscriptions that can be imported directly into clients.

> For learning and research only. Public node sources have unknown origins, can disappear at any time, and may log traffic. Do not use them to log into important accounts or transmit sensitive information, and assess the compliance risks yourself.

---

## How to choose a subscription

| Where you are | Which to use | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| **Mainland China** | `verified` | Passed real tests from overseas, and the mainland China probe can complete a TCP handshake with the node's port. The quantity is small (usually a few dozen), but these are the most likely to work directly |
| Overseas, or verified is not enough | `global` | Passing real tests from overseas is enough. Up to 300 nodes, sorted by composite score. Not guaranteed to be reachable from mainland China |
| Want to test yourself | `all` (on the `data` branch) | The full deduplicated candidate pool, about 27,000 nodes, **untested** |

Each tier comes in four formats: `.yaml` (Clash / Mihomo), `.txt` (Base64, for v2rayN / v2rayNG / Shadowrocket), `.json` (sing-box / Karing), and `.urls` (plaintext links, one per line).

# Win顺 Plugin Library

The plugin library supports the "unreviewed native plugins" category, with a minimum client version of Win顺 0.22.0. Community exe/dll packages are clearly marked as unreviewed, and installation and every update require user confirmation. For submission steps, see [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/LingCore/WinShun-plugins/blob/HEAD/CONTRIBUTING.md).

[Win顺](https://github.com/LingCore/WinShun) (WinShun) is a search launcher for Windows. Its plugins can add keyword commands to the search box. This is the directory of official and community plugins. The source code and release packages of community plugins are hosted in their authors' own GitHub repositories, while the source code of official plugins is in the main Win顺 repository and their release packages are in this repository. This repository registers an entry for each plugin as `plugins/<id>.json`, which specifies where to download it and the file's sha256. Win顺's plugin library reads the list generated from these entries.

## How to install

- Win顺 Settings → Plugins → **Plugin Library**, click "Install and enable", and confirm permissions when required. If you decline, the plugin stays installed but disabled. After Win顺 downloads a plugin, it first verifies the size and sha256; if they don't match, it won't install. Updates keep the existing enable/disable state.
- Or click the version number in the table below to download the `.wsplugin` file, then go to Win顺 Settings → Plugins → **Install from archive** and select that file.

Review the permissions a plugin requests before installing it.

Trojankill/Safe-server-lists-for-bypassi.description: Filtering insecure servers in public subscriptions
Trojankill/Safe-server-lists-for-bypassi.body:
# 🛡️ VPN Config Security Filter

---

### 🔬 Parsing and normalization

- ✅ **URI parser instead of regex** — vless / vmess / trojan / hysteria2 / ss / tuic are parsed into a structure
- ✅ **Double decoding** — `&amp;`, `\u0026`, `%5Cu0026`, `¬`
- ✅ **Invisible characters** — zero-width, BOM, `\n`, control chars are stripped before validation
- ✅ **Parameter synonyms** — `allowlnsecure` (with a lowercase L), `skip-cert-verify`, `skip_cert_verify`, `insecure`
- ✅ **Lowercase scheme** — `VLESS://` no longer breaks parsing
- ✅ **Insecure flags** — any value other than an explicit `0/false/no/off` is treated as enabled
- ✅ **vmess `"tls":"none"`** — no longer passes as valid TLS
- ✅ **Duplicates counted before limits** — one node with different names no longer pushes out legitimate configs

### 🌐 Addresses and protocols

- ✅ **`ipaddress` instead of regex** — 169.254/16, 100.64/10, 198.18/15, multicast, ULA
- ✅ **Obfuscated IPs** — `0x7f000001`, `2130706433`, leading zeros
- ✅ **Public DNS** — 1.1.1.1, 8.8.8.8 and 10 more addresses are rejected as “server”
- ✅ **Ports < 22** — junk from subscriptions
- ✅ **UUID validation** — for vless / vmess / tuic, null and reserved UUIDs are discarded

# DSH Go

DSH Go is a **native package manager + Registry/Distribution infrastructure + Marketplace** for the DeepSeek Harness ecosystem. The current architecture treats Package Protocol V2, Manifest V2, Registry V4, Resolver V2, Runtime State V4, and API V2 as the sole authorities, and no legacy interface compatibility layer is retained.

Authoritative API entry point: https://dsh-go.pages.dev/

> Core boundary: Marketplace/Edge is only responsible for discovery, querying, resolving, and generating installation plans; **Local Runtime is the only component authorized to perform installation, updates, rollback, state writes, and activation**. Remote pages/APIs cannot modify the user's machine, nor do they automatically restart the client.

## Final Architecture

```text
Package Protocol V2 / Manifest V2
                ↓
Discovery → Candidate / Quarantine
                ↓
            Registry V4
                ↓
        Trust + Policy Engine
                ↓
            Resolver V2
                ↓
          Resolution Plan
                ↓
        Runtime Supervisor
                ↓
        CAS + Transaction
                ↓
        Runtime State V4
                ↓
       Activation Manager
                ↓
       Runtime Adapter ABI
                ↓
          Health / LKG
```

The three external entry points are strictly layered:

```text
CLI / Desktop / Deep Link / Local Host
                 ↓
          Runtime Supervisor

API V2 / MCP Tools V2 / Marketplace
                 ↓
       discovery + resolve only
```

# mono

A monorepo for TypeScript projects: published libraries, applications, internal
tooling, and the Zenn articles published at <https://zenn.dev/noshiro_piko>.

## Setup

**Node and pnpm come from the repository, not from your shell's defaults.**
`tools/configs/node-support.json` is the single source of truth for the three
Node versions that matter here, and `pnpm run check:root:node-support` is what
keeps `engines.node`, `volta.node` and the compatibility matrix agreeing with
it:

| version           | what it is                                     |
| :---------------- | :--------------------------------------------- |
| `targets.current` | what a contributor builds on, and `volta.node` |
| `targets.lts`     | what is tested                                 |
| `targets.minimum` | the floor `engines.node` promises to consumers |

```sh
# Node: whatever pins it for you, at the version volta.node names
```

saitkul/tspu-class-test.description: A script for determining the TSPU "class" on your provider. It helps you work out within a few minutes which bypass strategy you specifically need, instead of blindly trying other people's public configs.
saitkul/tspu-class-test.body:
# 🔬 TSPU test — TSPU class of your provider for Zapret2

*LuCI application and CLI script for express diagnostics of your provider's TSPU filtering. In 5–20 minutes it objectively determines which desynchronization mechanisms your TSPU lets through, prints a ready verdict "TSPU CLASS", and generates a report for the provider map, instead of blindly trying other people's configs.*

## 🎯 Why is this needed?

Instead of copying other people's heavy public strategies, you get an objective picture of which techniques your TSPU lets through and which it blocks. This makes it possible to choose an individual, minimally sufficient strategy, reduce the load on your router, and speed up services. And if we collect results from different cities, we get a **country-wide filtering map**: which provider suits what at the moment.

## ⚡ What can the application do?

| Feature | Description |
|---|---|
| **16 strategies in 3 groups** | slicing without fakes (1–6) / bare fake with different fooling methods (7–10) / fake + slicing (11–16). Technique and «дурка» (junk) are separated, so it's clear what actually works |
| **“TSPU CLASS” verdict** | based on the results, the class is printed automatically: L0 / L0- / L2 / “special” / “not determined”, with an explanation and a recommendation |

xingyingyuzhui/XiaoHuang-s-Chemistry-Lab.body:
# Xiao Huang's Chemistry Laboratory

A local application for **middle school chemistry teaching and self-study**. On classroom displays, teacher computers, or during students' self-study, it uses a unified interface to present periodic table explanations, 3D molecule and reaction diagrams, calculation exercises, electron configuration demonstrations, and classroom interaction.

All data is stored locally in SQLite. Optionally, you can connect to the **DeepSeek API** for AI-generated questions, hints, molecule/reaction generation, and similar features. Only the prompts for each call are forwarded; business data such as rosters and exam papers stays on the local machine.
